title: Tech Note: Let’s Encrypt CERTBOT with a 4D Web Server
author: Timothy Aaron Penner, Senior Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note replaced 4D's own aging ACME component with the official Certbot tool because the ACME protocol had changed; Certbot remains the standard, actively maintained way to obtain free Let's Encrypt certificates for a 4D web server today, so this guidance is still broadly applicable.
related_updates: 4D's own bundled 16-17/17-01 Let's Encrypt component was retired in favor of the official, externally-maintained Certbot tool described here, which is still the recommended external tool
cert.pem/key.pem placement and HTTPS enabling in Database Settings remain the same in current 4D versions
